# Zamera — Extended Product & Privacy Knowledge Bundle (v0.1.5+6)
> Zamera — 100% On-Device True-Color Artwork Camera, Pro DSLR & Cinema Video Studio by Akarworks.

## 1. Canonical Overview
Zamera is a professional on-device camera and color science application developed by Akarworks for iOS 17.0+ and Android 10+. Engineered for deterministic reliability, 100% offline processing, and 60 to 120 FPS responsiveness, Zamera provides Art Mode true-color reproduction with a 24-patch ColorChecker CIEDE2000 solver (targeting Delta E00 <= 1.0), manual PASM exposure priority with 1/3-EV stops, 14-bit Bayer RAW and Apple ProRAW capture, and 180-degree shutter-locked Pro Video recording in Apple Log, ProRes 422 HQ, or HLG10. Version 0.1.5+6 introduces the hybrid transparent PNG sticker cutout engine with optional white sticker contour, and a full-screen Pro Media & Sticker Studio featuring A/B split curtain inspection, CIE L*a*b* pixel colorimetry, 64-bin RGB histograms, and an SMPTE cinema video player. Zero personal data is uploaded or tracked.

## 2. Privacy & Data Safety Guarantees
- Zero Data Collection: Zamera collects zero photos, videos, audio, location, telemetry, usage analytics, or device advertising identifiers.
- Offline Color & AI Pipelines: Embedded Rust `zamera_core` CIEDE2000 math, Android ML Kit Subject Segmentation + U2-Net cutout, and Apple Vision segmentation execute entirely on user device hardware.
- Minimal Permissions: Camera, Microphone (strictly during Pro Video mode), and local Media Storage (for saving DNG/JPEG/PNG/video files to DCIM/Zamera or Apple Photos).
- Regulatory Alignment: Fully aligned with KVKK (Turkey Law No. 6698), EU GDPR, and California CCPA via zero external data transmission.

## 3. Frequently Asked Questions
### What is Zamera and who is it for?
Zamera is built by Akarworks for artists, photographers, archivists, and mobile cinematographers who need calibrated color accuracy, full manual hardware control, transparent subject cutouts, and strict offline privacy.

### Does Zamera upload photos or stickers to any server?
No. All photos, RAW DNG files, videos, calibration profiles, and transparent PNG stickers remain strictly local on your device until you explicitly choose Share or Copy.
